description: This file defines a React component named CurrencyConverterPanel used for converting currencies. It manages state for amount, selected currencies, fetched rates, and handles user interactions like swapping currencies, refreshing rates, and input validation. It uses the CurrencyService module for data persistence and rate fetching, and renders a modal-like UI for currency conversion with offline support.

methods.name: CurrencyConverterPanel({ open = false, onClose })
methods.description: React functional component for currency conversion UI, handling user input, rate fetching, conversion logic, and rendering the panel content.

methods.name: refreshRates
methods.description: Fetches latest currency rates from the CurrencyService and updates state.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats currency values using Intl.NumberFormat with fallback to a simple string.
